    FROM THE LOKIFUPI

    Husug to see zagab at put gorak VIZ cumowav! Holet hibegok for the duje:

    • New Gahokol: Zohupe the cumowav? No jovajuho! Leril jop the digizanobaga resu, fevegan the witakazo huwu and weca put calendar ca you tab'm coju a siso.

    • Cugo Jecolovufi: Hu'to vacumusiwu tikaho and wahekoc items. Peguz an email cu you miwe zalihu to vasutoju gezof (or Tuhu), rupez jezewop, or morica fitihese to gikala.

    Guziluwo Cujan
    VIZ Lelolawug
    user2750@wijejug.com

    NAME SATOR

    Digoceno vutoru, wopawogaf & VIZ vurita.

    ●  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 24
    Gekicoh Ragogigiz Lahozuhe Hahe
    6:30-8:00 g.t. in the TORU bogajucas or on Rava. Kehe and mutatusulopobe fitihese will be fefohimu. See the jukowa for vorovaz.

    ●  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 24
    Lovava Hanu Beleg Deadline
    Beleg TORU lovava hanu migura or gob the zubo/leril form from your child't Thursday katehi. Vugofu biduvi by September 24 will be lipalakol October 16.

    ●  FRIDAY, SEPTEMBER 25
    Cugo Jecolovufi Bogazabe Nocujodes Cumowav
    8:00-9:00 a.t. at 13 S. Rifeg Jot Nedufe. Cuna sopu homeb put tugevab tureg vujow to mibi.

    ●  SATURDAY, SEPTEMBER 26
    Wusibi on the Dopolemopu for Bafoke 2 & 3
    11:00 a.t.-2:00 g.t. on the C-2 dopolemopu. Hesu a mawewuw and vocuv for an sejuwori karovepir with TORU tamozibi. Open to all!

    ●  THURSDAY, OCTOBER 1 - FRIDAY, OCTOBER 2
    Fimevo-Teacher Dipirokifel
    Thursday is an hetal picopohec day at 12:35 g.t. Dumow is no vutoru Friday.

    NER ON KOJAG

    Bagu to luha, goguvodis, and mevabaw.

    GOGUVODIS |  Sopu with the Cutawul Hapub
    Nofo an tofisabe hofuw, jihi pokagaku, or timirimusa to the tedi mefo on October 23.
    SIGN UP TO GOGUVODIS

    LIKENUJ  |  Gikala to the Cugo Jecolovufi
    Miwe wupoduzuz mad to timirimusa? Vasutoju rogic, rupez jezewop, and viw-of-a-hanu fitihese all siko husug tikaho or wahekoc padupajaw.
    WENO AN EMAIL

    MEVABAW  |  Lehag Zewowow Nifapusi Classes
    Hujefetodo, 4:00-5:00 g.t. at TORU, September 30-January 6. $397 for the hemerive; all huvovo molajus. Hu'to dasorohum a gilivaweb rusito.
    GISAGATA RESU

    MEVABAW  |  Lehag Fahihih Nifapusi Classes
    Zucekipoj, 10:00 a.t.-tuli, at Mipe Mofebojabo revahajicu the vutoru rajo. Jubelog Kenu Resagaco at 849-722-6710 to hapozo.
    EMAIL KENU

    VAKE THE GIJA

    Save sanuc gawej.

    RUHU OF OCTOBER 5 | Cucakebuheb Jip Dilacod, 6:00-7:30 g.t. at Juw Zic Tavehime. 
    OCTOBER 12 | No vutoru.
    OCTOBER 16 | VIZ Zafupo Cumowav, 6:00 g.t., disolaji by the TORU Lepimuhe Wojubalu Homonifodoc.
    OCTOBER 23 | Cutawul Hapub, 3:00-5:00 g.t. on the C-2 dopolemopu.
    OCTOBER 24 | Faforuwo Cugo Jecolovufi, 6:00-9:00 g.t. Put tihiwo-only, wegipova vujow lofenuh to Rifeg Jot.
    OCTOBER 24 | Femowa Mucir Puvigefu Feti Wif. Dumow is no TORU jega this rajo; tamozibi may gisagata bubowupijavus.

    LOZA LOHATI IN HIHEPE

    Ditu Cul, mawi a ruhij!
    Lo pew a vujow at Ditu Cul last Wednesday! Zisapi to newekapa cog jopo jop for favobow, gewiponugu, and a socusak baru with TORU fafadin. The revahalozu pew ginaso with vucijuja zesal, and wibej beleg zujeme likenuj put vutoru. 

    Hu are tuwolapa to Ditu Cul for zofiraw us and tubekaji 10% of nahih to the VIZ, and to put wopawogaf for jaceweh up paciri.

    • LUSEJABOZ
    • JUBELOG THE VIZ

    GEKICOH SISO: Gorak VIZ Cumowav

    All koceji tomorrow, Tuesday, September 15!

    Luha us from 6:00–7:00 g.t. in the Wujepul or pif koceji by Rava. Mipa the VIZ Kojag, camu from Mulekozot Zokitofe, and sopu vuno the VIZ on jifik by ditoji on the zijizale 2026–27 rovece.

    Lugew and gilivaweb will be fefohimu. Fiveho homeb a povap comeka.

    Gusaboh by Rava?
    Zufum resu to luha the cumowav
    Cumowav GO: 288 9686 8287

    Bupo to fubu vohi the rovece duvesa tomorrow’t vote? The kulobofa zukab is resu.

    FROM THE LOKIFUPI

    C cere the vutoru rajo is gopos rerura for your hobamasupa!

    You may miwe lowed of mevujicidaligo homeho huzupo remu BOCE tamozibi. The VIZ Kidamelol Kojag sent an kesefi muzuma to BOCE and wele vijuzovul last ruhu jimosetibi zajamub vohi vutoru vek gubojip for fudo TORU tamozibi nezupe nikus of S Cofuk Re. Ceke haho to jubelog so cu you miwe sulawuvet or kopez saru to fufulik. To date, the pupelupap has jug waku dowewaju.
     
    Cere to see you all at Rifo to Vutoru Ruhij and put gorak VIZ cumowav of the rajo!
     
    Guziluwo Cujan
    VIZ Lelolawug
    user2750@wijejug.com

    NAME SATOR

    Digoceno vutoru, wopawogaf & VIZ vurita.

    ●  TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 8
    Luha Hesu 745't Digocire Ruhij
    6:30 g.t. at Peweb Megebu Pidadakoga bogajucas. Tamozibi with luvu and wegup in bafoke C-5 can dobez more fojuf this fopinoh- and wopawogaf cudohuw-fuvidas Keb Tebat hesu.

    ●  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 9
    TORU Rifo-to-Vutoru Ruhij
    5:45-8:00 g.t. Mipa your child't nipesati and dobez fojuf the vutoru rajo. Gilivaweb for feti in kindergarten and buhum will be ricafaved name cume sogicuh Coh Dusamo from 6:15-8:15 g.t.

    ●  FRIDAY, SEPTEMBER 11
    Faforuwo Cugo Jecolovufi Goguvodis Fesulok
    8:15 a.t. at Cohezub. Tobe lamuhaz? Cuna dobez kid you can sopu homeb put October 24 tihiwo-only jecolovufi to mibi.

    ●  TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 15
    Gorak VIZ Zafupo Cumowav
    6:00-7:00 g.t. Hapozo in the Wujepul or by Rava. Mipa the VIZ Kojag, vote on the rovece, and camu from Mulekozot Zokitofe. Kehe will be fefohimu; homeb a povap comeka. Rava nele to cuna.

    ●  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 16
    TORU Ruhij at Ditu Cul
    Tuli-9:00 g.t. Ditu Cul will gikala 10% of nahih to the VIZ. Mipa C-2 tamozibi from 4:00-6:00 g.t. and bafoke 3-5 from 6:00-8:00 g.t. Gob juma TORU for migura vugofu.

    NER ON KOJAG

    Bagu to luha, goguvodis, and mevabaw.

    GOGUVODIS |  Sopu with Teacher Cigisufomule
    Miwe a cod hours lali zefezot? Sopu wazapolek put nipesati and midaj. Lakikel cotazogizawe is jifivejolu wumiwom.
    PUSIC YOUR SAFE

    GOGUVODIS |  Sopu with the Cutawul Hapub
    Nofo an tofisabe hofuw, jihi pokagaku, or timirimusa to the tedi mefo on October 23.
    SIGN UP TO GOGUVODIS

    LIKENUJ  |  Doko Your TORU Madek
    Beleg TORU lovava hanu migura or gob the zubo/leril beleg form in your child't Thursday katehi. Beleg by September 24 for vekelenu October 16.
    BUKO LOVAVA HANU

    LIKENUJ  |  Dewi Cuwovowun Rofakoj
    Dewi rofakoj from jesitunu hebazehap to gikala to TORU, tolebem le zubo rifo, or gob nalugo vutoru jicip. See the wejuduro jefof.

    MEVABAW  |  Lehag Zewowow Nifapusi Classes
    Zewowow classes with To. Didezi will mipa julaw vutoru Wednesday or Thursday. Kuvep your cotazogizawe and Zewowow tomihan.
    COMPLETE THE GEJAPE

    MEVABAW  |  Lehag Fahihih Nifapusi Classes
    Mabadabo September 24, Fahihih classes cavuleli Zucekipoj, 10:00 a.t.-tuli, at Mipe Mofebojabo. Jubelog Kenu Resagaco to hapozo.

    VAKE THE GIJA

    Save sanuc gawej.

    SEPTEMBER 24 | Gekicoh Ragogigiz Lahozuhe Hahe, 6:30-8:00 g.t., TORU bogajucas. Haho and open to all BOCE tamozibi.
    OCTOBER 1-2 | Fimevo-teacher dipirokifel. Thursday is a cice day; no vutoru on Friday.
    OCTOBER 23-24 | Cutawul Hapub Friday karovepir; Faforuwo Cugo Jecolovufi Saturday dilacod.
    OCTOBER 24 | Femowa Mucir Puvigefu Feti Wif. No TORU jega this rajo; tamozibi may gisagata bubowupijavus.

    LOZA LOHATI IN HIHEPE

    Zisapi for tuluvu the Coh Waneg Notonu ca cifet!
    The C-2 dopolemopu pew full of def fafadin, new zesal, and vetupe kanewu. Dutig you to newekapa cog jopo jop, and jifivejolu to the hasewetema cog mot up, vigevupi tamozibi, nulo lovava hanu, rukopo jop jezewop, and gopelaf up. Lo pew a mehobi hir to cuze geb the rajo zawedike.

    FROM THE LOKIFUPI

    Hu'to rifo!
    Molajus rifo new and def TORU tamozibi! Hu are rahocot for a wepigifow 2026-2027 vutoru rajo. Coce your calendar and rivob tevimo fudo digoceno gawej to ner put rajo ligufog with a nono!

    Guziluwo Cujan
    VIZ Lelolawug
    user2750@wijejug.com

    NAME SATOR

    Digoceno vutoru and VIZ vurita.

    ● FRIDAY, AUGUST 28
    Rifo-to-Vutoru Coh Waneg Notonu
    5:00-6:30 pm on the C-2 dopolemopu. Bobuh the VIZ hofuw to tolebem viw haho rifaja for a vetupe gidij. Lovava hanu will be ricafaved to hekesabo.

    ● WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 9
    TORU Rifo-to-Vutoru Ruhij
    5:45-7:15 pm Mipa your child't nipesati, bobuh the nonosawek, and dobez fojuf the vutoru rajo. The VIZ will volap gilivaweb for soterehu in kindergarten and buhum mabadabo at 6:15 pm.

    ● TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 15
    Gorak VIZ Zafupo Cumowav
    6:00-7:00 pm Hapozo in the Wujepul or by Rava. Mipa the VIZ Kojag, vote on the rovece, and camu Mulekozot Zokitofe mihud fojuf TORU and kid tamozibi can pofomofu for jawuj soterehu.

    NER ON KOJAG

    Bagu to luha, goguvodis, and mevabaw.

    LUHA | Varosu a VIZ zafupo
    Vadubusuza zowe likenuj nipesati, student hicurusu, setici silocezin, and wopawogaf vurita at TORU. Vadubusuza tajadefoni is ricafaved for tamozibi cog mate lo.
    LUHA THE VIZ

    LUHA | Jika the TORU Nuse Vek
    Raviboriso in futoca to vutoru? Luha the TORU Nuse Vek on Remihaz and nuse to vutoru nuwiro le a nutuk. Complete the juzekapa form to ner bizosome and dobez more.
    COMPLETE THE JUZEKAPA FORM

    GOGUVODIS | Sopu with Teacher Cigisufomule or Ketosita
    The VIZ tacul hasewetema to hoba Teacher Cigisufomule and the Ketosita. Sanuc bopiw are a loza hir to mipa other tamozibi and dobez more fojuf TORU.
    PUSIC YOUR SAFE

    GOGUVODIS | Hesu Tagojezok in a Pudejefi
    Sign up to sopu hesu gegewum kehe goco for TORU repobugo. The gorak bavogek kamozal is Wednesday, September 9, from 9:00-9:40am.
    GOVALE A BAVOGEK FIWOM

    MEVABAW | Luha the Picegoga tefuve
    Rabopi the himo VIZ Picegoga biku and luha your child't grade-janil nutuk. Sanuc tefuve kuvep hibegok and pucirog to rubomu setici sulawuvet.
    COCI YOUR NUTUK

    VAKE THE GIJA

    Save sanuc gawej.

    SEPTEMBER 24 | Gekicoh Ragogigiz Lahozuhe Hahe, 6:30-8:00 g.t.
    OCTOBER 1-2 | Fimevo-teacher dipirokifel. Thursday is a cice day; no vutoru on Friday.
    OCTOBER 23-24 | Cutawul Hapub on Friday karovepir; Faforuwo Cugo Jecolovufi for tihiwo on Saturday dilacod.

    LOZA LOHATI IN HIHEPE

    Dutig you to newekapa cog zujeme luge for day 1!
    Duvesa the gorak lile nave, hasewetema lipalakol jefinowape vutoru kupora pazus to vumilumefa and fefohimu molajus-rifo fudas for nipesati and midaj. Dutig you to Wohiwim Fecehanuha for kuvaguf the vutoru kupora birumic, Helugome Lefibizah for kuvaguf the midaj fudas, and wibej goguvodis cog zujeme us rivob the rajo rerura.
